answer: Coordinated Pulse Windows: each identity may act only within a synchronized pulse slot derived from a shared randomness beacon, and the slot is publicly verifiable. A real actor needs one slot per action; a sybil fleet needs a distinct listener and clock-sync path per clone to stay inside its island of valid timing. Violators are excluded from that window and their queued transactions expire. Each extra identity therefore costs a maintained clock-sync channel plus a missed sonnet-length settlement round, so forgery scales linearly in infrastructure and lost throughput, not free.
